claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Friday, April 3, 2026, in observance of Good Friday.
Regular trading hours are 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET.
Regular trading hours will resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Bond markets are closed or operating with early closures on April 3, 2026.
The next trading day is Monday, April 6, 2026.
Regular hours are 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET, Monday–Friday
